claims.statement: Harmonised Annex VIII notifications have been required for in-scope hazardous mixtures on the EU market since 1 January 2025.
The workflow must preserve a one-composition UFI relationship and complete composition or valid MiM references.
PCN is a recurring change-control problem: significant composition change requires a new UFI and linked new notification, and other product or market changes can require updates.
A 2026 enforcement pilot found 19% of 1,597 checked mixtures unnotified, which establishes a compliance gap but not willingness to buy this product.
The current PCN format is XML-based, updated annually and available with schemas and validation rules, so a production product needs annual compatibility and regression work.
External consultants may work through client-granted foreign-user access, making a lawful service workflow possible without customer impersonation.
A new distributor duty applies from 1 January 2027 to certain cross-border, rebrand and relabel situations when the relevant information is not already held by the appointed body.
Free ECHA Cloud, desktop, portal, validation and S2S routes materially constrain a software-only value proposition.
SAP and UL already offer integrated PCN/UFI capabilities, leaving the smaller private-label segment and confidential cross-record release control as a possible but unvalidated wedge.
No reviewed source verifies target-customer portfolio sizes, current consulting spend, formula-custody acceptance, prices, margins, channel commitments or founder conflict clearance.

contrary_evidence: Free ECHA tooling covers preparation, validation, multimarket submission and automated S2S submission.
SAP and UL offer incumbent PCN workflows integrated with broader product-compliance data.
The 2027 distributor duty is avoidable where the upstream notification already covers the market and identifiers.
An enforcement gap does not reveal a paying segment and may include firms with low complexity or low willingness to comply.
Annual XML-format changes add product cost and error liability.
Trade-secret risk and employer conflict can outweigh the data-lineage fit.
